title: Non-metallic SERS on MoOx/AZO heterostructures: role of charge transfer and polarons
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37109-37124
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05314E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Trong Vo Huu, Nhi Nguyen Bich, Thanh Cu Duy, Tuan Dao Anh, Ke Nguyen Huu, Hung Le Vu Tuan
In this study, a non-noble-metal SERS substrate based on MoOx/Al-doped ZnO (AZO) heterostructures was successfully fabricated using a cost-effective DC magnetron sputtering method.
